title: The One-Star Guest Who Became a Regular

scenes.say: Monday. Ivan leaves Roma Tom one star. My latte was cold.
Roma Tom replies the same day. You're right, Ivan, and I'm sorry. Your next one's on me.

props.caption: The reply, *same day*
props.name: Ivan
props.text: My latte was cold and nobody noticed.
props.reply: You're right, Ivan, and I'm sorry. Your next latte is on me, made hot, by me.

scenes.speaker: Ivan
scenes.say: Okay. I came back. That latte was perfect.
Three months later, Ivan's stamp card is full. He's in every Tuesday.
A one star review is a guest who still cares enough to tell you.
